open_questions: Google's setup page and protected-resource metadata publish different Drive scopes. The Dossier follows the setup page; whether Use Discovered provides equivalent access is unconfirmed.

blockers.problem: The first-time wizard steps are presented unconditionally even when the Google Auth platform is already configured.
blockers.suggestion: Make steps 3–13 conditional on clicking Get Started, then route both branches to Data Access.

blockers.problem: The transcluded Manual OAuth skeleton omits the canonical fact that the Redirect URI has a copy button.
blockers.suggestion: Restore the copy-button detail from doctrine/speakeasy-setup.md and render it in speakeasy.md.

blockers.problem: An administrator using an already-configured Google Auth platform may skip adding connecting accounts as test users because the condition applies only to readers who selected the External audience themselves.
blockers.suggestion: Tell every reader to open Audience, check whether the app is External and in Testing, and add all connecting accounts under Test users when both conditions apply.

blockers.problem: The missed-secret recovery names no navigation path or exact controls for deleting the unavailable secret and creating its replacement.
blockers.suggestion: Research and record the browser-only recovery path with exact console labels, then add those steps after the missed-secret warning in external.md.

history.revision_notes: Made the first-time OAuth wizard conditional and routed both branches to Data Access; required every reader to verify External/Testing status and add test users; restored the Redirect URI copy-button detail; documented and rendered the exact browser recovery path for replacing a missed client secret, with provenance. Metadata and guide lint pass.

blockers.problem: The screening prerequisite omits Google's requirement to document a non-Model Armor solution so users can accept its risk.
blockers.suggestion: State that the security owner may use Model Armor or must document any alternative screening solution for users.

nits.problem: The existing-configuration branch does not say what to do when an Internal audience excludes a connecting user.
nits.suggestion: Record the supported remediation and render a Dossier-backed stop-and-consult-owner hedge for this case.

history.revision_notes: Blocker: added Model Armor-or-documented-alternative screening prerequisite to research, metadata, and external guide. Nit: documented and rendered the Internal-audience remediation and owner-consultation stop. Metadata validates successfully.
